a: J3 resolution of the COUPLED ceiling residual handed over by J2-R2-7 / J2-R3-3. The coupling is real and its mechanism is receipt WAITING: a lambo_receipt call that waits is a long-lived in-flight request at the proxy, so N concurrent receipt waits are N entries in the pump's `inflight` list and therefore N frames in answer_lost's un-raced write burst. J3 therefore bounds BOTH ends: RECEIPT_WAIT_MAX caps how long any one wait can occupy an inflight slot, and a concurrent-waiter cap keeps the population under proxy.rs's INFLIGHT_DEPTH_WARN = 64. The queue bound itself does NOT feed the inflight list — a non-waiting ack returns immediately — so the residual's phrasing (the receipt ceiling IS the burst length) is true only of the waiting surface, and that correction belongs in the record.
b: J2 round-3 residual coupling, handed to J3 as ONE item: the pump's un-raced client-facing writes and the uncapped `inflight` list are the same problem. answer_lost (src/mcp/proxy.rs:1457) writes one frame per in-flight id, so the ceiling J3 chooses for outstanding receipts is also the worst-case LENGTH of an un-raced write burst to a client that may not be reading. Neither §J2 nor DIAL_BUDGET's residual section says the other exists, and both undercount the writes as 'two' when there are six un-raced Self::send sites (proxy.rs:1298, 1321, 1349, 1375, 1393, 1457).
